Name: -OBSOLETE-Kisekae
Author: KabigonFirst
Description:
[b][b][size=5]WARNING!!!:  This Mod is OBSOLETE due to the character creation being changed in 1.4!  It will NOT work in SDV 1.4... at all! [/size]

NOTICE:[/b]
There are some missing files in Version 2.1-beta. If you already downloaded, please upgrade to 2.1.1-beta. Sorry for that.

Introduction:[/b]
A modified version of Get Dressed mod that works with Stardew Valley 1.3. Version 1.* is a quick fix to make it works with 1.3 single player mode and behave almost the same as Get Dressed. From version 2.0-beta, there's a big change. New features(including multi-player fixes) are added and may behave differently compared with Get Dressed. The configuration file is compatible with Get Dressed though new options are added.

[b]Multiplayer Issues:
[/b]From version 2.0, the mod should work well with multiplayer mode (except coop menu).
BUT
If you want to use the mod in multiplayer mode, It's strongly recommended to have all players with the same appearance overrides  because there are some known cases can cause game crash immediately.
You can turn on "multiplayer Fix" option in menu to synchronize appearance with your friends.
If your friend don't have this mod, make sure "multiplayer Fix" option is off.
[b]CAUTION:[/b] In multiplayer mode, if you turn on "multiplayer Fix" but your friend doesn't have this mod, his/her game will [b]crash[/b].

[b]Config File Issues[/b][b]:
[/b]Current (i.e. first) skin color, hair style, bottom color and accessory config are now saved in per save config file (Get Dressed won't save these) so that player appearance will totally depend on per save config file(except first run). Upon closing the customization menu, per save config file will be updated in this way.

[b]Ways to Access Customization menu[/b][b]:[/b]
[list]
[*]The official way is by access WizardShrine (costs $500 each time) after you are at least 4 heart friendship with Wizard. This way is always supported. If you want to have this way only, you can change MenuAccessKey to "None"  and ShowDresser to false in config file.
[*]Check the dresser in farm house (farm hands should also be able to see the dresser in farm house now).
[*]Set a menu access key(by default, it's C).
[/list]
